note: Both sets suffer from severe circuit number misalignment due to the two-column layout, resulting in many wrong bindings (e.g., Refrigerator assigned to circuit 11 instead of 9-10). Set A is preferred because it extracts more complete and readable entity descriptions, whereas Set B includes garbled text like 'PTACLES' and 'ACLES' and more vague 'Main Panel' claims. Set A also captures more distinct loads (Furnace, Oven, Dryer) despite the binding errors.
